children: Venezuela's monthly inflation slowed slightly to 8.4% in September from 8.9% in August, according to central bank data released on Saturday.
Annual inflation stood at 465.5%, according to Reuters calculations based on the central bank figures.
Inflation in the first nine months of the year reached 225.3%, the data showed.
